assembly_hypotheses.dimension_and_set: Integer d>=2, compact E, dim_H(E)>d/2; start with a Frostman exponent S+chi>d/2.
assembly_hypotheses.preparation: Separated compact original supports with prepared cross directions; decreasing Borel Gamma_N of positive limiting original product mass; at most C*R^(2*d*omega) spatial products; power-small cap-control deletion in both original marginal fibers.
assembly_hypotheses.exceptional_reduction: In odd dimension, an affine k-plane carrying positive mass is handled separately by the classical distance threshold; auxiliary projections elsewhere control directions only.
assembly_hypotheses.entry: 0<beta<min(chi/10,1/10); sufficiently small sigma and kappa; profile normalization, Lipschitz and lower bounds; nonterminal [c,N].
assembly_hypotheses.restoration: Original class masses, 0<=Theta_N<=1, W=|x-y|^(-(d-1)/2) bounded above and below, exponentially small total-variation deletion, nonzero monotone limit carried by original compact distances.
assembly_hypotheses.shell: Uniform root weighted conversion and two-profile graph estimates, one-profile conditional bounds including identical cells, parameter order beta/kappa/sigma/omega, and fixed accuracy/derivative orders before N grows.
assembly_hypotheses.reconstruction: Finite positive decreasing alpha_N, summable ||alpha_N-tau_N||_TV, and summable square roots of the tau_N shell integrals.
